content.title: Orsted Stock Plunges After White House’s Offshore Wind Project Shutdown. It Isn’t the Only One Exposed.
content.summary: The White House’s latest move to shut down an offshore wind project is having wide ripple effects because it ups the ante on what kinds of projects the Trump administration will halt.  The Interior Department halted work on the Revolution Wind project off Connecticut and Rhode Island late on Friday, citing unspecified “national security interests.”  Shares of  Orsted  the Danish company building the project, plunged 16% in Denmark’s Monday session.
